thingsToDo.title: Vero Beach shoreline
thingsToDo.description: Use the Atlantic beaches for sunrise, swimming, walking, and a lower-density coastal experience than South Florida's larger resort cities.

thingsToDo.title: McKee Botanical Garden
thingsToDo.description: Explore subtropical gardens, water features, and historic landscape design in a shaded setting.

thingsToDo.title: Indian River Lagoon
thingsToDo.description: Paddle or boat the lagoon to see mangroves, birds, and estuarine habitat on the city's inland-water side.

thingsToDo.title: Vero Beach Museum of Art and Riverside Park
thingsToDo.description: Combine the museum, park, and lagoonfront cultural district for an easy half day.

thingsToDo.title: Pelican Island National Wildlife Refuge — nearby federal refuge
thingsToDo.description: Visit or view habitat associated with the nation's first national wildlife refuge, while keeping it separate from Vero Beach municipal land.

thingsToDo.title: Sebastian Inlet State Park — separate park
thingsToDo.description: Head north for surf, fishing, beaches, and inlet ecology at a separately managed Florida state park.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Cooler months are easiest for outdoor planning
bullets: Late fall through early spring generally brings lower humidity and comfortable outdoor conditions.
Summer is hot, humid, and storm-prone; start exposed activities early and keep afternoon plans flexible.
Busy winter and holiday periods reward advance reservations for popular tours and timed attractions.

travelTips: Group each day by geography instead of crossing the region repeatedly.
Use early mornings for exposed outdoor activities and waterfront time.
Check park, marine, and weather conditions before nature-focused plans.
Treat nearby municipalities and protected areas as separate destinations with their own access rules.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Vero Beach?
faq.a: Two to three days is a good starting point for the core sights plus one outdoor or regional experience.

faq.q: Is Vero Beach good for outdoor travelers?
faq.a: Yes. The strongest itineraries combine the destination itself with nearby water, parks, preserves, or trails.
It depends on the destination, but a car or guided tour is often useful for protected lands and regional excursions.

faq.q: Should I book tours in advance?
faq.a: For high-demand wildlife, boating, park, and holiday-period experiences, advance booking is sensible.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Vero Beach is an incorporated Atlantic coastal city in Indian River County.

sections.heading: Geography & setting
paragraphs: The developed barrier-island beach area and mainland are separated by the Indian River Lagoon, creating both ocean and estuary environments.

sections.heading: History & culture
paragraphs: Citrus history, arts institutions, coastal neighborhoods, and a quieter tourism scale distinguish the city.

sections.heading: Outdoor & seasonal highlights
paragraphs: Beach walking, lagoon paddling, fishing, birding, and nearby refuge or state-park visits drive outdoor planning.

sections.heading: Getting around
paragraphs: A car is useful because beach, mainland, lagoon, and regional preserve stops are spread across bridges and coastal roads.
